format.description: Marks a Deep read; a Deep card from before has no format.

id.description: The section's name within the read, unique in it; the page links to it and a render targets it.

title.description: The section's name as shown ("Finding 2 · A softmax law for the read").

claim.description: The paper's key claim in one sentence.

items.description: One point that carries the paper's argument.

state.description: Whether the thing named is there (yes) or missing (no); left out for a plain tag.

tags.description: Short marks in place of, or after, the text: what is released and what is not.

anyOf.description: At a glance, always first: the key claim, the points and the facts (kind, models, task or data, methods, code, reading time).

id.description: The section's name within the read, unique in it; the page links to it and a render targets it.

title.description: The section's name as shown ("Finding 2 · A softmax law for the read").

kind.description: What the section is: the problem and motivation, the method, or one finding.

takeaway.description: The section in one line; the contents of the read outside the web app show it.

text.description: A subheading inside a section, plain text.
The paper's reason for a choice, placed at the choice it explains.
The read's own sceptical remark, where the paper's text does not say it.

where.description: Where in the paper this rests: a section, figure or table, as the paper numbers it ("§5.3, Table 2").

tex.description: The equation in TeX, as KaTeX reads it in display mode, without delimiters.

caption.description: What the equation says, and what is empirical about it.

name.description: The figure's name among the read's figures; its image is stored with the read under this name.

number.description: The figure's number in the paper, as the paper labels it ("Figure 6").

caption.description: A caption in the read's own words.

label.description: A short tag for the experiment ("1a").

not_shown.description: What it leaves open, including the controls that hold.

group.description: A heading across the table, over the rows that follow it.

note.description: A short note on this cell, shown on hover or tap; plain text.

items.description: A cell: its value (plain text or a number; an empty string for an empty cell), or its value with a note.

sum.description: True for a totals row, set in bold.

items.description: A row of cells, or a group heading.

max.description: The value coloured at full strength.

colour.description: The heat's colour; red when left out.

heat.description: Colours each numeric cell after the first column by its value, where the values compare.

caption.description: Where the table comes from and how it was cut ("Rebuilt from Table 1, eleven of its 22 rows").

width.description: The drawing's width in its own units; coordinates run from 0 to it.

height.description: The drawing's height in its own units.

id.description: The node's name within its diagram, which edges refer to.

label.description: The node's name, plain text, one line.

sub.description: A second, smaller line under the name.

colour.description: The node's colour; neutral when left out.

x.description: The left edge of the node's box.

y.description: The top edge of the node's box.

tip.description: What the node does and the numbers behind it, shown when it is clicked.

from.description: The id of the node the edge leaves.

to.description: The id of the node the edge points at.

label.description: A few words drawn beside the edge, plain text.

title.description: The heading of the edge's explanation; its label when left out, else the two nodes' names.

style.description: How the line is drawn; solid when left out.

items.description: A point, [x, y], in the diagram's units.

points.description: The edge's path from start to end, through its waypoints. Left out, it is a straight line between the two boxes.

anchor.description: Which part of the label sits at the point; middle when left out.

label_at.description: Where the label is drawn; the middle of the path when left out.

tip.description: What passes along the edge and the numbers behind it, shown when it is clicked.

lanes.description: Names of the diagram's bands, each drawn at its point.

caption.description: What the diagram was drawn from.

anyOf.description: A diagram the read draws: nodes and edges, each explained. A stored read always carries coordinates: the deep service lays a diagram out before it stores the read, and the web app only draws.

relation.description: How this paper stands to that one.

note.description: One sentence on where the two meet: the shared question and what differs.

among_collection.description: Papers the lab's collection holds (store.search hits with in_collection true), recent and on the same question, that this paper agrees with, contradicts, extends or supersedes. Only relations both papers' texts support; empty when none does.

source.description: Who wrote the note: the agent, or the service after the run.

note.description: One sentence: what could not be done or checked, and what the read says because of it.

url.description: The page concerned, an absolute http(s) URL.

process_notes.description: What the run could not do because of its tools, access or budget, not what the paper lacks.

title: Read
description: A Deep read. Its prose fields are inline text: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, $tex$ for inline maths and [words](https://…) for a link, and nothing else; HTML is shown as written. Names, labels, headers, table cells, cell notes and paper locations are plain text.
